_comment: First-run defaults. Copied into the per-install stores (app-prompts.json) the first time the server finds one missing, then never read again — editing this changes what a NEW install starts with, not what an existing one has. Each shelf maps a prompt name to its text; an empty string is a named row waiting for wording. Each replacement names its prompt as Shelf/Name — the server resolves that to the prompt id and takes a text snapshot, so no id or wording is written twice. The Female rows embed [hair] and [outfit] on purpose, as the worked example of a prompt built from other prompts: pick one Female row and the shelves it names come with it.

Action.Selfie Pose: she is holding a phone in front of her, she is taking a selfie
Action.Swing for Ball: she swings a tennis racket and hits a green tennis ball
Action.Victory Pose: she holds up a peace sign, her arm bent, she leans down bent at the waist

Expression.Flirty: she is smiling coyly, her head tilted, her eyes looking up in a flirtatious manner
Expression.Intense Concentration: she is focused, her eyes narrowed, her mouth slightly open
Expression.Tongue Out Silly: she sticks her tongue out while smiling

Female.Athletic: she is a fit young adult female, she has light tan skin, a toned body and frame, muscular legs, [hair], [outfit]
Female.Curvy: she is a curvy young adult female, she has light tan skin, an hourglass figure with a hyper-thin waist, [hair], [outfit]
Female.Petite: she is a very small cute young adult female, she has light tan skin, a cute face, a very skinny body and frame, skinny legs and arms, [hair], [outfit]

Hair.Brunette Ponytail: she has a silky brunette ponytail, her hair tied back with a ribbon
Hair.Luscious Blonde: she has long, wavy blonde hair, shiny and voluminous

Male.Sitting: he is a large cropped male, he is sitting
Male.Standing: he is a large cropped male, he is standing

Outfit.Athletic: she wears athletic wear, fitted leggings, sports bra, running shoes
Outfit.Professional Suit: she wears a professional suit, fitted blazer, pencil skirt, high heels
Outfit.Sun Dress: she wears a light summer dress, floral pattern, flowing fabric, sandals
Outfit.Tennis: she wears a tennis outfit, short skirt, fitted top, tennis shoes, wristbands

Scene.Library: library interior, dimly lit desks, bookshelves, people reading
Scene.Public Park: outdoor public park, trees, grass, people walking dogs
Scene.Tennis Court: outdoor tennis court, bleachers with people watching
